Unlock Your Future: The TNPSC Combined Technical Services Examination (Diploma/ITI Level) 2026

Are you a skilled Diploma or ITI holder aspiring for a stable and rewarding career in the Tamil Nadu government? The Tamil Nadu Public Service Commission (TNPSC) Combined Technical Services Examination (CTSE) (Diploma/ITI Level) is your gateway to diverse technical positions across various state departments. This blog post provides a comprehensive overview of the latest recruitment, key details, and essential preparation tips to help you navigate your path to success.

Latest Updates & Vacancies: TNPSC CTSE 2026

The TNPSC has announced the latest recruitment drive for the Combined Technical Services Examination (Diploma/ITI Level) for 2026. This year, the notification details a significant number of revised vacancies, offering promising opportunities for qualified candidates. The recruitment process aims to fill various non-interview posts in different government departments and organizations.

Important Announcement: For the 2026 recruitment cycle, the TNPSC has revised the vacancies to 476 across 45 different posts. The online application commenced on May 27, 2026, with the last date to apply being June 25, 2026.

Key dates for the 2026 recruitment include:

Event Date
Online Application Start Date May 27, 2026
Online Application Last Date June 25, 2026
Application Correction Window June 29 to July 1, 2026
Physical Certificate Verification & Counselling July 3, 2026

Previous examinations have seen various posts advertised, such as Junior Training Officer, Assistant Tester, Draughtsman, Field Surveyor, and Junior Draughting Officer, among others.

Eligibility Criteria: Are You Qualified?

To be eligible for the TNPSC CTSE (Diploma/ITI Level), candidates must meet specific requirements concerning educational qualification, age limit, and knowledge of Tamil.

✅ Educational Qualification: Candidates must possess a Diploma or ITI certificate in a relevant trade from a recognized institution.

✅ Age Limit: The minimum age is typically 18 or 21 years, while the maximum age varies depending on the specific post and candidate category. Age relaxation is provided for reserved categories as per government rules.

✅ Knowledge of Tamil: Adequate knowledge of Tamil is generally required. Candidates who have studied Tamil at SSLC, HSC, or Degree level, or through Tamil medium, can provide evidence. Others may need to clear a Second Class Language Test.

Exam Pattern & Syllabus: Your Roadmap to Preparation

The TNPSC Combined Technical Services Examination typically comprises a written examination with two papers. Understanding the structure and syllabus is crucial for effective preparation.

1. Paper I: Tamil Eligibility Test, General Studies & Aptitude

Paper I usually includes a Tamil Language Eligibility Test (Part A), which candidates must qualify with a minimum of 40% marks. The questions for Part A are set only in Tamil. Following this, Part B covers General Studies, and Part C assesses Aptitude and Mental Ability. The questions for Parts B and C are set in both English and Tamil.

Key topics in Paper I often include:

  • Tamil Grammar, Vocabulary, Comprehension, and usage of Tamil language (Part A)
  • General Science, Current Events, Geography, History and Culture of India, Indian Polity, Indian Economy, Indian National Movement (General Studies)
  • Simplification, Percentage, HCF & LCM, Ratio and Proportion, Simple & Compound Interest, Area, Volume, Time & Work, Logical Reasoning (Aptitude & Mental Ability)
2. Paper II: Subject Paper

Paper II is a subject-specific paper, varying based on the post applied for. It covers topics from relevant engineering or technical disciplines.

Common engineering subjects include:

  • Civil Engineering
  • Mechanical Engineering
  • Electrical Engineering
  • Automobile Engineering
  • Electronics and Instrumentation Engineering
  • Agricultural Engineering
  • Other specialized trades relevant to ITI qualifications (e.g., Electrician, Fitter, Welder, Surveyor).

Only the marks from Part B, Part C of Paper I, and Paper II are considered for ranking purposes.

Application Process: How to Apply

The application process for the TNPSC CTSE is conducted entirely online through the Commission's official website.

1. One-Time Registration (OTR)

If you are a new applicant, you must first complete the One-Time Registration (OTR) process on the TNPSC website. This involves creating a unique user ID and password.

2. Online Application Submission

After OTR, log in with your credentials and proceed to fill out the online application form for the Combined Technical Services Examination. Ensure all personal, educational, and other required details are accurately entered.

3. Upload Documents and Pay Fee

Upload scanned copies of necessary documents, including educational certificates, photographs, and signatures, as per the specified format and size. Pay the application fee online. Exemptions for certain categories are applicable.

4. Application Correction Window

A correction window is typically provided after the application deadline, allowing candidates to make necessary edits to their submitted forms.

Selection Process

The selection process for the TNPSC Combined Technical Services Examination generally involves multiple stages to ensure the most suitable candidates are chosen.

✅ Written Examination: Candidates must appear for Paper I and Paper II. Failure to appear for either paper will result in disqualification.

✅ Onscreen Certificate Verification: Shortlisted candidates based on written exam marks and reservation rules will undergo onscreen certificate verification.

✅ Physical Certificate Verification & Counselling: Finally, provisionally shortlisted candidates will be called for physical certificate verification and counselling.

✅ Final Selection: The final selection is based on the candidate's performance in these stages.

Why Choose a Career Through TNPSC CTSE?

Securing a position through the TNPSC Combined Technical Services Examination offers numerous advantages for Diploma and ITI holders.

✅ Stable Government Employment: Enjoy job security and a reliable career path within the Tamil Nadu government.

✅ Competitive Salary & Benefits: Selected candidates receive a respectable basic pay ranging from Rs. 28,480 to Rs. 56,900, along with various allowances such as DA, HRA, TA, and EPF.

✅ Diverse Opportunities: Work in various departments and contribute to public service in technical roles.

✅ Career Growth: Opportunities for advancement and professional development within the government structure.

The TNPSC Combined Technical Services Examination (Diploma/ITI Level) presents a golden opportunity for skilled individuals to build a fulfilling career in the Tamil Nadu government. Stay updated with official notifications, understand the syllabus, prepare diligently, and seize this chance to transform your aspirations into reality!
